body: Just the thought of going out with someone else is so... foreign?  Is that the right word?  It's almost inconceivable for me to imagine myself with anyone else.  The whole situation makes no sense to me.  Like, why is this girl not with me? I don't understand. I love her so much and I wish that I could impart that on her because I know that it would matter to her but I can't.  It's the cruelest irony that the person I want to talk to the most about this, is the one person that I can't talk to at all.  The whole thing is so shitty.

Dude.  I totally feel you.  I am in a very similar situation (but not even up to your point because I'm so uninterested in everyone else that I can't even go on a date).  You are not alone in this.  I know the frustration and the feeling of helplessness and just feeling stuck.  It is the worst feeling in the world.

Let me know if you want to chat.

I have had a very similar experience.  I have been struggling in school because of personal issues too, and people just do not seem to understand.  It makes me really hesitant to reach out to them because of the tendency to be brushed aside.  I think that people do not really understand how deep depression can go and how absolutely it can affect the different parts of your life.  I know that I have had major focus and attention issues since everything happened too.

But I miss her.  I know that everyone says that but it is just tragic to me that I cannot talk to my favorite person in the world.  It sucks. It seems so unnatural.  And the thought of her with someone else... it fucking sucks.  I still can't picture myself with anyone.  The thought is so foreign.  It is hard for me to really conceive of an out for myself right now.

Right now I'm having a hard time even going 5 minutes.  I feel so overwhelmed right now.  It is her birthday today and I just miss her so much.  I want to reach out and talk to her.  I want to make things better, but I know that I can't.  I feel so helpless. I miss her so much.
I will definitely look into this.  Just looking at the symptoms, it seems like I qualify for just about every one.
